what: text-to-speech round trip per voice with uccharan and with espeak-ng through bolo, two runs

run_1_60_sentences.conditions: 2 threads, shared 4-vCPU x86_64 (Intel Xeon 2.10GHz), no GPU, other jobs running; sherpa-onnx 2.0.1; uccharan 0.1.0 (wheel built from its repository); espeak-ng 1.52.0 (espeakng-loader); English STT whisper-base (sherpa-onnx int8) with Whisper's English normaliser; Hindi STT indicconformer-hi-community, punctuation stripped, NFC
run_1_60_sentences.sentences: last 60 lines of uccharan tools/eval/data/en_heldout.tsv and hi_heldout.tsv

run_2_500_sentences.what: paired: each sentence synthesised with both phonemisers (per-request phonemizer, alternating order), both transcribed back; 95 % interval of WER(uccharan) - WER(espeak-ng) by paired bootstrap over sentences (2000 resamples, seed 11, the method of uccharan's tools/eval/e2e_tts_asr.py)
run_2_500_sentences.sentences: 500 per language picked as uccharan's e2e_tts_asr.py picks them from its held-out sets (en: 30-120 characters, ASCII, no digits; hi: 15-120 characters, no Latin letters or digits; shuffled with seed 7), passed through bolo's normal text normalisation
run_2_500_sentences.conditions: bolo 0.2.0, 2 threads per process, two voices measured at a time on the shared 4-vCPU x86_64 (no GPU); 1-minute load average 0.8-5.3 during amy and rohan, 3.2-7.0 during lessac and alba (other jobs); sherpa-onnx 2.0.1, uccharan 0.1.0, espeak-ng 1.52.0 (espeakng-loader); STT whisper-base (en, Whisper English normaliser) and indicconformer-hi-community (hi, punctuation stripped, NFC)
